notes.title: Deck of Memories x Tiny Teams!
notes.content:
[p]Guess what folks...

Deck of Memories has been officially selected for the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025"]Tiny Teams Festival[/url] here on Steam! 😮[/p][p][/p][p]For the next week, you’ll find us alongside an amazing lineup of pint-sized powerhouses, proving that you don’t need a big team to make some of the best games out there. So grab your virtual popcorn, come say hi on stream, and let’s celebrate all things indie 💪💛[/p][p][/p][p]From our tiny team to you - a heartfelt thank you for your support![/p][p]- Sentiment Games 🐦‍⬛[/p]

notes.title: Deck of Memories is Forged in Germany!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone!

We’re incredibly excited to share that [b]Deck of Memories[/b] is taking part in the [b]"Games Forged in Germany"[/b] event on Steam! 🎮🇩🇪  

This showcase is all about celebrating the creativity, passion, and diversity of games developed right here in Germany, and we’re proud to be a part of it! It’s truly an honor to be featured alongside so many amazing titles with our small team.   

👉 [b]Check out the full showcase and explore all the fantastic games[/b]: 
[url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Games-Forged-in-Germany"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Games-Forged-in-Germany[/url]

Thank you for your support - Auf Wiedersehen!
Sentiment Games ❤️ [/p]
